headlines.title: Trump threatens to pull Todd Blanche’s AG nomination until after GOP holdouts leave office
headlines.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee postponed a vote on Blanche’s nomination over objections from Sens. John Cornyn of Texas and Thom Tillis of North Carolina.

headlines.title: Democrat Mandela Barnes drops out of Wisconsin governor’s race
headlines.description: Barnes, the former lieutenant governor and 2022 Senate nominee, departs amid democratic socialist Francesca Hong’s rise in the polls ahead of the Aug. 11 primary.

headlines.title: Democrats’ novel red-state strategy: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur explores how Democrats are trying to increase their odds of defeating Senate Republicans in deep-red states.

headlines.title: FBI investigating possible ties between Iran and cyberattacks on Minnesota water systems
headlines.description: The FBI is investigating possible ties between Iran and cyberattacks on Minnesota water systems. Meanwhile, sources tell NBC News that President Donald Trump is "exasperated" regarding Iran as top officials can't agree on strategy. NBC News' Monica Alba reports.

headlines.title: OpenAI’s ‘rogue’ agents hacked into more systems than initially reported
headlines.description: NBC News AI reporter Jared Perlo discusses an incident where OpenAI’s models went rogue and hacked into a separate AI company.

headlines.title: Francesca Hong ‘undecided’ on seeking endorsement from Mandela Barnes after he suspends campaign
headlines.description: Gubernatorial candidate state Rep. Francesca Hong (D-Wis.) joins Meet the Press NOW after former Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes suspends his campaign. Hong also discusses her path forward to the Democratic nomination.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: ‘Alien Terrorist Removal Court,’ created in 1996, holds first-ever hearing
headlines.description: DOJ holds first-ever hearing of ‘Alien Terrorist Removal Court,’ created in 1996

headlines.title: States push DHS to explain its noncitizen voter claims
headlines.description: State officials are pushing back on the Department of Homeland Security’s claims that it found tens of thousands of noncitizens on their voter rolls, asking the department to explain how it arrived at its conclusion.

headlines.title: U.S. strikes Iran after Trump reportedly issues menacing new threat
headlines.description: The fighting shattered a brief period of calm after weeks of escalation between the U.S. and Iran over the strategic Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Senate committee postpones vote on Todd Blanche’s nomination over disagreements with GOP senators
headlines.description: Two Republicans on the Judiciary Committee said they have not received the assurances they’re seeking from the Justice Department regarding the Trump-IRS settlement.

headlines.title: Todd Blanche’s rocky road: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we dig into the uncertain paths forward for Todd Blanche’s attorney general nomination and the Iran war.
